sprint_goal: Deliver a unified payment admin workspace enabling treasury ops to search batches, manage refunds, approve payouts, and generate audit reports with full PaymentCore and Payment Rail integration.

tasks.title: Implement merchant and payment batch search UI
tasks.description: Create search and filter components in Next.js using shadcn/ui for merchants and payment batches with real-time pagination, ensuring results load under 1.5 seconds from PaymentCore GraphQL.

tasks.title: Integrate PaymentCore GraphQL for search queries
tasks.description: Develop GraphQL client in TypeScript to fetch merchant, batch, and settlement data via API Gateway with mTLS and OAuth2 client credentials flow.

tasks.title: Build settlement timeline and transaction drill-down view
tasks.description: Design and implement interactive timeline visualization that retrieves ledger and event data from PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs for selected payment batches.

tasks.title: Develop refund and adjustment initiation flow
tasks.description: Implement refund/adjustment trigger through Payment Actions service using Payment Rail REST APIs, ensuring audit logs are emitted to Kafka and S3 archives.

tasks.title: Implement payout approval workflow with automated allocation rules
tasks.description: Add manager approval UI with role-based gating and backend logic applying automated allocation rules and audit logging via Payment Actions service.

tasks.title: Configure RBAC enforcement for OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles
tasks.description: Set permissions and feature flags in frontend and backend ensuring restricted access to approval and refund actions per defined roles.

tasks.title: Implement anomaly alert display in dashboard
tasks.description: Consume Payment Rail event streams and render anomaly alerts with merchant and batch context in workspace dashboard.

tasks.title: Develop audit-ready report export and S3 archival
tasks.description: Create export functionality for auditors to download CSV/JSON reports; implement S3 archival with proper IAM policies and audit logging.

tasks.title: Add integration test suite for payment actions and approval flows
tasks.description: Write automated tests in Jest to validate refund, adjustment, and approval logic with Kafka audit message verification.

tasks.title: Prepare deployment scripts and private VNet configuration
tasks.description: Configure CI/CD pipeline for deploying Next.js and backend services inside private VNet ensuring mTLS setup and no external calls.

risks.description: API latency from PaymentCore or Payment Rail could exceed performance SLAs
risks.mitigation: Implement request caching and optimize GraphQL query fields; monitor latency metrics and fallback to async updates if necessary.

risks.description: RBAC misconfiguration could expose sensitive payout approval screens
risks.mitigation: Verify RBAC permissions in staging with test accounts and conduct role-specific UAT review before production release.

risks.description: Audit log emission to Kafka/S3 may fail under high load
risks.mitigation: Implement retry logic and error monitoring for Kafka producers and S3 uploads during heavy transaction peaks.

risks.description: Integration complexity between PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST may delay backend delivery
risks.mitigation: Stub endpoints early for UI development and conduct mock integration testing in parallel to reduce dependency delays.

risks.description: Analyst dashboard performance may degrade under multi-region concurrency
risks.mitigation: Enable client-side pagination and limit result sets; perform load testing simulating 60 concurrent users.

definition_of_done: All user stories pass acceptance criteria with verified audit logs in Kafka and S3
RBAC validated for OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles
UI responsive and search/performance metrics meet SLA (<1.5s search, <4s payout)
Integration tests for refund and payout approval workflows succeed
Code reviewed and merged to main with CI/CD deployment inside private VNet
Sprint demo completed and documentation updated for Treasury Operations onboarding
